title: feat(audit): the activity stream shows each changed field's old → new values by default, served only for fields the reader may read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Part of #36290

PR 1 of 3 (spec + server). PR 2 draws per-field rows on the record page from the served change code, and PR 3 adds the per-field history card (`Fixes #36290`). Shape approved by the seat (option B: a new key, `enable.fieldHistory`, with no default), per ruling 7076513167.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: carried by #36419

## 维护者速读

- 记录的动态里，每个被修改的字段现在默认显示「字段：旧值 → 新值」，所有对象都一样；对象写 `enable: { fieldHistory: false }` 可整体关闭，字段写 `fieldHistory: false` 可单独关闭。成员只能看到自己有权读取的字段的修改，不开放 `sys_audit_log`。
- 属于「记录页字段修改历史」：以前只有逐个字段写了 `trackHistory: true` 才显示值，其余修改只写字段名。新开关没有默认值，所以已构建或已存储的对象升级后直接生效，不需要重新构建。
- 若出错，可能表现为成员看到不该看到的字段值（读取侧已按字段逐条收窄并有测试钉住），或某条动态写入失败（摘要已按 500 字符上限截断）。可整体撤回，已写入的动态行不受影响。
- 升级注意：`trackHistory: false`（对象上或字段上）都不再关闭值显示。要关闭，对象请写 `enable.fieldHistory: false`，字段请写 `fieldHistory: false`。字段设计器以前每次保存都会写 `trackHistory: false`，所以这个值不能当作关闭开关；仓库内 44 个平台对象已补上对象级开关。

## What changes

**Spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, `field.zod.ts`, forms):
- New `ObjectCapabilities.fieldHistory: z.boolean().optional()` with no default. Absent: values show. `false`: values off for the object. It has no default on purpose: `ObjectSchema.parse` materializes every defaulted `enable` key whenever an `enable` block exists, so a default would be written into every built artifact and stored definition (measured: 33 of 38 hotcrm objects carry an `enable` block). With no default, an upgraded install gets values with no rebuild.
- `enable.trackHistory` keeps its schema and meaning (default `false`; with `true` the default record page reads the compliance ledger and the derived `history` verb is served). Its describe now says that value display is `fieldHistory`'s question.
- New `FieldSchema.fieldHistory: z.boolean().optional()`, no default: the field's off switch. Absent: values show. `false`: the change is named by label only. `true`: values show, a media or JSON type included. Under an object with `enable.fieldHistory: false`, values stay off whatever the field says.
- Field `trackHistory` keeps its schema. `false` now reads like absent (values show): the field designer wrote `trackHistory: false` on every save while the key meant nothing (`FieldDesigner.tsx`, persisted by `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`), so a stored `false` cannot be told from a choice. `true` keeps one job: it opts a media or JSON field in.
- Object form `enable` composite offers `fieldHistory`; the object form's `fields` repeater and the field form offer the field `fieldHistory`. Each row's help text says that unset means on, although the switch shows off. Liveness entries `object.json#fieldHistory` and `field.json#fieldHistory` (live, evidence `audit-writers.ts#changeValuesShownFor`).
- The two closures over every `FieldSchema` key classify the new key: driver-sql `FIELD_KEY_STORAGE_CLASS` (`presentation`: `createColumn` never reads it) and metadata-core `FIELD_REFERENCE_POSITIONS` (`keep`: a boolean that names no field). The metadata-protocol `field` property count moves 84 → 85.

**Writer** (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`):
- `changeValuesShownFor(objectDef)` decides per changed field: off when the object writes `enable.fieldHistory: false`, or the field writes `fieldHistory: false`, or the field is a credential (`collectMaskedReadFields`: `secret`, and `password` off better-auth objects — both sides would be the same mask). Media and structured-JSON types (`image`, `file`, `avatar`, `video`, `audio`, `signature`, `composite`, `repeater`, `record`, `location`, `address`, `code`, `json`, `vector`) show values only with an explicit `fieldHistory: true` or `trackHistory: true`. Everything else is on, including a field that writes `trackHistory: false`.
- `renderTrackedChangeSummary` and `planTrackedLookupReads` take that predicate instead of reading `trackHistory === true`.
- The stored summary is fitted to `sys_activity.summary`'s `maxLength` (500) by `fitStoredChangeSummary`: each side is cut to 60 characters first, then trailing changes are left out (`; …`). Before this, the tracked branch was not fitted, so a long value would fail the insert under default-on. The `summary_message` code keeps every change, each side capped at 1,000 characters.

**Read side** (`activity-field-redaction.ts`, `activity-summary-message.ts`, `audit-plugin.ts`):
- The `fieldChanges` code (`metadata.summary_message`) is now served to readers, narrowed change by change with the same `resolveServedFields` answer as `metadata.old` / `metadata.new`. A reference field's change is kept only for a reader served the referenced record's title (`referenceTitlesPerRead`). Any other code is still stripped for non-system readers, and `text_sources` stays stripped.
- When a reader is not served the stored summary, it is recomposed from the narrowed changes in the reader's locale instead of dropped whole. A row whose every change is withheld is still withheld as a row.
- The summary-locale middleware is now registered before the redaction middleware, so redaction runs inside it and the locale composer sees the narrowed code.

**44 in-repo objects** that wrote `trackHistory: false` now also write `fieldHistory: false`, so their "no history" holds: cloud-connection `sys-cloud-binding-credential`; metadata-core `sys-metadata-audit`, `sys-metadata-commit`, `sys-metadata-history`; platform-objects `sys-attachment`, identity `sys-account`, `sys-device-code`, `sys-jwks`, `sys-oauth-access-token`, `sys-oauth-client-assertion`, `sys-oauth-client-resource`, `sys-oauth-consent`, `sys-oauth-refresh-token`, `sys-oauth-resource`, `sys-personal-view`, `sys-session`, `sys-two-factor`, `sys-user-preference`, `sys-verification`, system `sys-lifecycle-state`, `sys-migration-journal`, `sys-migration`, `sys-platform-setting-audit`, `sys-platform-setting`, `sys-recycle-bin`, `sys-secret`, `sys-seed-landed-key`, `sys-setting-audit`, `sys-setting`, `sys-trusted-key`; plugin-audit `sys-activity`, `sys-audit-amendment`, `sys-audit-checkpoint`, `sys-audit-log`, `sys-audit-signing-key`, `sys-comment-reaction`; plugin-sharing `sys-share-link`; service-automation `sys-connector-connection`, `sys-connector-credential`, `sys-flow-credential`; service-messaging `channel-account`, `channel-user-link`, `user-device`; service-realtime `sys-presence`. hotcrm at `689166c`: 0 objects write `trackHistory: false` (reported to the seat; nothing pushed there).

**Files that moved because the default flipped** (approved by the seat as growth within the ruling):
- *Object-form translation bundles, 11 locales* (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`): the new `enable.fieldHistory` label, and the two `trackHistory` help texts, which still said "opt-in per field". Why it moved: the form offers a new row, and the old help text is now false. Since review round 1 they also carry the field `fieldHistory` row labels and the new help texts. Count pins move with them: `object-collapsed-sections-echo-decisions.test.ts` (panel leaves 117 → 119, capabilities 11 → 13, open leaves 128 → 130) and `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (positive control 756 → 759).
- *Two dogfood files*: `field-history-tracking-activity.dogfood.test.ts`, whose website-only leg pinned the label-only frame and now reads `Website: https://before.example → https://after.example` (why: `website` declares no `trackHistory`, so it is on). `activity-label-display-field.dogfood.test.ts`: its `REF_TITLED` fixture gets `enable: { fieldHistory: false }`. Why: those pins read the update frame that names the record by its label (the referenced title). With values on, the update's summary would be `Name: titled → titled again`, which names no record label, so the withheld/served pair would pass without testing anything. With values off, the frame still names the record label, so the pins keep testing whether the title is served.
- *Checklist item* `records-forms.field-history-tracking` rev 16: title, acceptance[1], negative[0], automated.ref and source[1] said values were opt-in per field. Why: they now describe the shipped default.
- *Four hand-written docs*: `protocol/objectql/security.mdx` §7, `data-modeling/objects.mdx` flag table, `data-modeling/fields.mdx` and `data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx` `trackHistory` rows. Why: each said values were opt-in.

## Review round 1 (L2 7078144432 FAIL, L1 7078132570 REWORK)

- **M1, designer-saved `trackHistory: false`.** Closed by a field key of its own instead of a conversion (seat OK'd). A stored-row conversion was measured and rejected: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts`) replays the whole chain on every read with `includeRetired: true` and no version window. So a conversion that drops field `trackHistory: false` would also erase every deliberate opt-out saved after the upgrade, on every load. With `fieldHistory` as the off switch, a stored `trackHistory: false` reads like absent, so fields already saved through the designer show values after the upgrade with no conversion. Census: no code-authored field in `packages/**` or `examples/**` writes `trackHistory: false`; all 45 occurrences are object-level `enable` blocks (44 objects plus a comment).
- **S1, two-state switch.** Each `fieldHistory` row and the field `trackHistory` row now have help text. Renderer, read at this head: `SchemaForm.tsx` draws a boolean as `<Switch checked={!!value} onCheckedChange={(c) => onChange(c)} />`. So an untouched switch writes nothing, and only a toggle writes `true` or `false`. It cannot show unset apart from `false`: an unset `fieldHistory` shows as off while values show. The help text says this. A third state is a renderer change that no PR on this card carries.
- **Nits.** The field describe now says an object `enable.fieldHistory: false` wins over a field `true` (pinned). Not taken: `tree` changes still show a stored id, and multi-value option types show stored values joined by commas. The card's acceptance names select, lookup and user, and those three resolve.
- **L1.** `Skills-docs: carried by #36419`. #36419's step 1 still names field `trackHistory: false` as the field's off switch. At this head it is field `fieldHistory: false`, and the seat owns that card's text.

## Census: every reader of `enable.trackHistory` (seat rider)

None of these reads changes meaning, because `trackHistory` is untouched:
- objectstack `packages/spec/src/data/api-derivation.ts` (`history` verb, `=== true`).
- ui `RecordDetailView.tsx` (`historyEnabled`: `!== true` → no ledger read); `appObjectScope.ts` (`recordStreamObjectNames`, `=== true`); `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` (opt-in toggle; writes an explicit boolean; a `fieldHistory` toggle is PR 2).
- `plugin-approvals` `approval-service.ts` (type only); cli `explain.ts` (doc example); metadata-core `object-schema-fls-references.ts` (key list).
- Not readers: database-loader's `trackHistory` is an unrelated loader option; driver-sql `builtin-column-collision` is a name map; hotcrm has comments only.
- UI producers of the field key: `FieldDesigner.tsx` writes `trackHistory: data.trackHistory === true` on create and edit (so every save writes an explicit `false`), and `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` reads `!!def.trackHistory`. Since this head that `false` reads like absent, so it no longer changes behaviour. PR 2 moves both producers to `fieldHistory`.

## Tests

- `audit-writers.test.ts`, new describe `[#36290] a changed field shows old → new unless the object or the field turns it off`: absent → on; `enable.fieldHistory: false` → label only; `enable.trackHistory: false` alone → still on (the upgrade note); field `fieldHistory: false` → label only; field `trackHistory: false` (what the designer wrote) → values still show; object `enable.fieldHistory: false` wins over field `fieldHistory: true`; `json` with `fieldHistory: true` → on; credential → label only; `json` → only with `true`; a long value inserts at ≤ 500 with each code side capped at 1,000 and `…`; 30 changes fit with `; …`.
- `activity-field-redaction.test.ts`, `[#36290]` code pins: a system reader gets the full code; a masked reader's code omits the masked field; an unserved reader's code and recomposed summary omit the unserved field; the control reader gets it all; a non-`fieldChanges` code is still not served; a reference change is kept only under the title rule. These fail if the per-change narrowing is removed (each asserts the absent field is absent from summary, code and old/new).
- `spec/src/data/object.test.ts`: a parsed `enable` block carries no `fieldHistory` key, and `false` survives parse.
- Fixtures that pin the label-only frame now say so (field `fieldHistory: false` or `enable.fieldHistory: false`): `audit-milestone-summary`, `audit-lookup-summary`, `audit-writers` (amount, campaign, person_qualification), `activity-lookup-name-field-label-34055`, `activity-summary-reader-locale.integration`.

## Verification

Head `d531553a`: `c43a42bb` plus one changeset line naming `@objectstack/driver-sql` at patch (L1 7080045587); the figures below were measured at `c43a42bb`, and this commit changes no source. Round 2 (`6e416547` the field key, `17772933` the metadata-protocol count, `c43a42bb` the two key closures) on top of round 1 (`851997e6`).

- plugin-audit full suite: 109 files / 1809 tests passed (round 2).
- spec `src/data` 187 files / 6708 passed; platform-objects translations 610 passed; metadata-core full suite 27 files / 1048 passed; driver-sql `builtin-column-collision` 2 files / 18 passed; metadata-protocol `meta-types-degenerate-derivation` 18 passed; lint `validate-security-posture` + `rule-explanations` 232 passed; cli `data-model-rules` 65 passed; service-messaging and metadata-core `builtin-column-storage-attributes` 18 passed.
- Ablations at round 2 (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after): removing the field `fieldHistory === false` check of `changeValuesShownFor` reds 4 tests in `audit-writers.test.ts`; making field `trackHistory: false` an off switch again reds the `designer_saved` pin; removing the driver-sql `fieldHistory` row reds `classifies EVERY FieldSchema key, and invents none`. Round 1's ablations (per-change narrowing 9 of 40, `enable.fieldHistory` branch 8 of 139) still hold.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` at round 2: 128 commands, every one exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran`: 128 derived, 128 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. This sweep does not derive the driver-sql and metadata-core key closures; CI's Test Core 3/10 and 10/10 found them at `17772933`, fixed in `c43a42bb`.
- Full dogfood battery at `c43a42bb`, after rebuilding driver-sql and metadata-core under the verify lock (build VERDICT command-exit 0): `vitest run` lock VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 484 passed / 3 skipped (487), Tests 4107 passed / 68 skipped (4175), no failures. The same battery at `6e416547` + `17772933` gave the same counts.
- CI at `c43a42bb`: 70 check-runs completed, 60 success and 10 skipped, none failed (Test Core 10/10, Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI and workspace, every Lint lane, Build Core, Build Docs, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness).
- `overlap-check` at `d531553a`: clean against `origin/main`; overlap with #36449, which also adds a top-level `FieldSchema` key and moves the same `field` count 84 → 85 and the same two closures. Whichever lands second merges main and makes the count 86.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/audit-writers.test.ts src/activity-field-redaction.test.ts -t 36290`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.ts`: the per-change narrowing of `summary_message` and the recomposed summary.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`: `changeValuesShownFor` and `fitStoredChangeSummary`.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`: the middleware order.
